ticket: So I'm just trying to get back into the Northbeam account for the nonprofit, but I keep getting the 'invalid token' error even after resetting the SSO key on our Google Auth server, and honestly I'm starting to think the whole team might be affected because I saw a Slack message from one of the staff saying they can't log in either, but I know that's not right since only the admin should be blocked, right? Anyway, we've been using this SSO setup for over 7 years and I remember when we first switched from local auth to SSO, the IT guy from another department had to manually fix the configuration on a Tuesday morning, and I swear I saw a spreadsheet with 'Access Logs' in it that had the word 'failed' everywhere, but that was back in 2018 and I don't know if that's relevant anymore. Anyway, I need to get into the account to verify that the SSO connection is working properly and maybe update the client list in the admin panel, and if it's not working, I'll have to contact the IT team again to reconfigure it via the SSO settings, which is a little messy because we have to do it through the old portal that hasn't been updated in years.

SSO sync failing for 3 departments, users see 'authentication timeout' after 15 seconds, data shows correct but can't access dashboards, invoice #874234 shows incorrect seat count due to this, not billing issue
Our invoice for April was charged twice, and we're being asked to pay again. The second charge appears to be a duplicate. We need a refund and clarification on why this happened.

I've been having issues with the export functionality in the reporting dashboard—specifically, when trying to generate monthly financial summaries, the exported CSV files come back with blank data fields even though the underlying data appears correct in the live view. This is preventing us from providing accurate reports to our clients on time, and we've had to manually recreate the data using spreadsheets, which is time-consuming and error-prone. In addition, I noticed that the 'task completion' progress bar in the project board occasionally resets to zero after a few hours, but this doesn't seem to impact the overall workflow significantly.

I'm having trouble with the shift scheduling feature in the app — when I try to assign shifts to team members, the assignment saves but the updated schedule doesn't reflect on the team dashboard, and the shifts appear as blank until I refresh the page multiple times. It's been happening for the past two days and seems to happen consistently during the morning shift planning, even though the underlying data shows the assignments are correctly recorded. I can still see the shifts in the list view, but the visual board is always out of sync, which makes it hard to coordinate with the warehouse staff. In passing, I also noticed that the notification system for shift changes is now sending duplicate alerts every time I update a shift, but I'm not sure if that's related or just a side effect.
I'm trying to export all our customer data for our quarterly audit, but I can't find a way to do it in the app. Can you please help me get a full data export?

I'm really sorry for the trouble, but I've been trying to get a full export of all our project data for the last few days, and I'm having no luck — it's been showing as 'processing' for over 24 hours. I'm currently considering switching to a competitor who offers more transparent data exports, so I just need to confirm what data is actually stored in my Northbeam account and how to access it in case I decide to proceed with the transfer. I'm not sure if this is a system issue, but I'm worried about losing the historical records that are critical for our accounting. Could you please help me get a complete list of what data is retained and where it's stored?
My invoice number 876543 has been charged twice for the April subscription. I did not agree to this extra charge. Please remove the second payment and send me a refund.
Need full export of all project logs and client data from Q1 to Q3. Also, delete all data linked to this account. No access to backup files.

I'm so sorry for the trouble — I accidentally reset my password on the phone and now I can't access my Northbeam account. I’ve tried resetting the 2FA device, but it’s not recognizing my recovery email. My invoice #INV-789452 is due in two days and I’m worried we’ll miss the deadline without access to the project tracker.

We're absolutely devastated to report that our entire team of 40 people can't access Northbeam right now — the login page is completely blank and we're seeing 503 errors across all devices, even after clearing cache and trying different browsers. This has completely halted our order tracking and inventory sync, which is critical for our e-commerce operations, and we've just received a customer complaint about Order #E2849735 that we can't reconcile due to missing data. We’re completely out of options and are worried about impacting our delivery timelines and trust with our clients. We’ve tried reaching out to your support team via other channels, but we can’t even log into the system to see if there’s a resolution in progress.
Project board not loading for any staff. All users see blank screen. Tried refresh, reboot, no change. How long until fix?
